title: Wine Wimsey Review · Fri Nov 13
subtitle: Batch date Fri Nov 13 (ODD day): plain cards at queue positions 1,3,5,7,9; character posts at 2,4,6,8,10. 10 feed posts + 4 stories, volume/format test, no captions or first comments. Characters: Bold One 2 (#2, #10), Settled One 1 (#4), Homebody 1 (#6), Hot Mess 1 (#8); stories Hot Mess, Homebody, Settled One, Bold One. Seasonal: 4 of 10 feed (plain #3 dining table leaf, plain #7 Thanksgiving list; character #2 peeling potatoes, #6 flannel sheets) plus story 1 (seating chart); Thanksgiving is Nov 26, so all work on the Nov 13 publish date. No weekday references. Inbox: no new items. Quote sourcing: 2 spun (FFF: hit-and-run life #1, curfew/lied-about-where-you-were #5), 3 original plain cards (#3 replaced twice, #4 replaced once), 5 original character quotes, 4 original story quotes. FLAGS: (1) Only 2 FFF winners were still unused (premium adulthood was already spun earlier, and the menopause blanket/Antarctica line is too close to the used 'frozen tundra / surface of the sun' joke), so 2 spins instead of 3 and 3 originals. (2) Credits: 9 images x ~45 = ~405; 5 plain cards free. (3) Image checks: every image viewed, every quote matches word for word. Minor: the Homebody in story 2 again has a darker skin tone than her other images; the model added a cat to story 3 and to the new #4.
